title: Nanonets Overview
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.nanonets.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

Nanonets is a platform for turning complex business processes into agents. You build with two primitives: agents and context graphs.

Agents do the work. An agent reads incoming documents, applies your business rules, decides what to do, escalates when it is uncertain, and writes structured results into your systems of record. Agents run multi-step workflows without a human in the loop.

Context graphs hold the rules agents work from. A context graph stores your business rules as a machine-readable structure where every constraint is a node and every dependency is an edge. It selects the right rule for each situation, shares rules across every agent that needs them, and records which rule drove which decision. Build a context graph once and ANY agent can read from it.

Teams use Nanonets for accounts payable, order management, reconciliation, claims processing, and supplier onboarding. Agents handle invoices, receipts, purchase orders, bills of lading, contracts, claims, and forms in any format, with no per-template setup. Data extraction is powered by Nanonets OCR-3, ranked #1 on the IDP Leaderboard, and the workflow is driven by Nanonets agents and context graphs.

Every agent decision is traceable to the document it read and the rule it applied. Low-confidence results route to a human reviewer, and corrections update the rule for every agent that shares it.

Start with the Quickstart. For support, reach out at [support@nanonets.com](mailto:support@nanonets.com).
